title: Economy
description: Understand the Star Atlas economy through a cleaner, higher-trust frame that explains ownership, marketplaces, rentals, and industrial systems without overload.
heroTitle: The economy should feel legible before it feels deep.
heroSummary: This page gives the economy one clear narrative: assets, production, and trade create persistent stakes across the Star Atlas universe. The design prioritizes trust over jargon and removes stale, brittle proof points.
utilityLine: Precise numbers were intentionally de-emphasized here unless they can be kept current. The page leads with stable value propositions instead.

heroMedia.label: Economy layer
heroMedia.caption: A cleaner framing of ownership, production, and trade.

heroPanel.title: This page avoids stale metrics in favor of durable clarity.
heroPanel.body: Product confidence drops when old dashboards and outdated numbers dominate the story. The redesign explains the economy through structure, not fragile statistics.
bullets: Stable concepts over easily outdated claims
Marketplace and industrial loops clearly separated
Ownership framed as utility plus aspiration

sections.heading: Four layers that make the economy understandable.

cards.title: Marketplace access
cards.body: The entry point for browsing assets, evaluating opportunity, and understanding the breadth of the ecosystem.

cards.title: Rentals and flexible access
cards.body: A stronger economy is one that allows people to test roles and capabilities without all-or-nothing commitment.

cards.title: Industrial loops
cards.body: Crafting, extraction, and logistics make ownership useful beyond speculation.

cards.title: Persistent strategic value
cards.body: Assets matter more when they connect to territory, fleet readiness, and operational choice.

sections.heading: The economy page should reassure first, then intrigue.
body: A first-touch economy page does not need to prove everything at once. It needs to show visitors that there is a coherent system behind the marketplace and that participation has meaningful texture.
That is why the redesign emphasizes structure, access, and player intent instead of drowning the page in dashboard fragments or repeated CTAs.
sections.asideBody: Here the job is simple: make the economy feel coherent, premium, and worth engaging with.

items.question: Why remove detailed live stats from the hero?
items.answer: Because stale proof erodes trust. Unless metrics can stay current and contextual, the page is stronger without them.

items.question: What is the recommended next step from here?
items.answer: Open the marketplace for immediate exploration, then move into SAGE Labs or the game overview depending on your level of intent.

items.question: How does this stay premium instead of reading like financial software?
items.answer: The visual system keeps the economy in the same cinematic world as the rest of the site, while the copy stays direct and high-trust.

finalCta.title: Explore the economy with less ambiguity.
finalCta.text: Open the marketplace now or continue into the browser and industrial systems that give the economy operational weight.
